column1: # PRs that GitHub reports as MERGED but whose change is not in main -- either
# the merge commit is not an ancestor (stranded), or it is an ancestor and was
# reverted -- together with the PR that actually put the change into main.
# Read by .github/scripts/check-milestone-landed.sh.  A row here is NOT a way
# to skip that check: the replacement PR's own merge commit must be an ancestor
# of the tree being released AND must not itself have been reverted, or the
# For a DELIBERATE revert -- a change backed out because it does not belong in
# this release -- do not add a row here.  Move the PR off the milestone
# instead; that is the honest record and clears the check on its own.
# A row is needed because a re-land is normally a cherry-pick, which creates a
# new commit — the original merge commit stays unreachable forever, so without
# this record the recovered PR would be flagged at every future release.
